1.consolidated_definition: Personal dedicado a pilar el grano de café seco para eliminarle la película o cascarilla que lo cubre, haciendo uso de un pilón. Era trabajo indistintamente de mujeres y hombres diestros. El pilón era de una sola pieza; de mucho fondo y ancha boca; hecho de recia madera de ausubo o guayacán.
1.en_consolidated_definition: The person responsible for pounding dry coffee beans to remove the film or husk that covers them, using a mortar and pestle. This task was performed by skilled individuals of both sexes. The mortar was typically made from a single piece of sturdy wood, such as ausubo or guayacán, with a deep bowl and wide mouth.
